units.source_text: 俊吉邀请她到书房兼客厅的八铺席房间坐下，

en.t: Shunkichi invited her into the eight-mat room that served as both study and sitting room and had her sit down,
books were piled about the room in disorder,

units.source_text: 尤其是阳光照耀下的隔扇旁边的紫檀书桌周围，

en.t: especially around the red sandalwood desk beside the sunlit sliding partition,

units.source_text: 凌乱堆满了报纸、杂志和稿纸，让人眼花缭乱。

en.t: newspapers, magazines, and manuscript paper were heaped there in such confusion that it dazzled the eye.

units.source_text: 房中唯一能看出有年轻妻子共同生活的痕迹的，

en.t: the only thing in the room that suggested he shared his life with a young wife

units.source_text: 只有放在壁龛旁边墙侧的一张新古琴。

en.t: was a single new koto set against the wall beside the alcove.

units.source_text: 有那么一会儿时间，信子打量了整个房间。

en.t: For a little while, Nobuko looked over the whole room.
